title: Ubugingo Bureba Ku Nkombe y'Uruzi
intro: Umuntu ukiri muto yahawe ubutumwa bw'ibanga, bwo kwitegereza ari kure uko iherezo rye ryabaga riri ku mazi. Kubera ko atashoboraga kubibona cyangwa ngo abyitezweho, uyu muntu yazagira uruhare runini mu guhindura amateka y'igihugu.
clues: Nahawe akazi na mama, kasabaga kwihisha no kuba maso.
Amaso yanjye yakurikiraga agatambaro gato kari gatembera mu mugezi, umutima wanjye uremerewe n'amaganya.
Ubwo yabonekaga n'umuntu utari witeze, narayegereye mfite ubwoba bwinshi.
Nabonye ko babuze umurinzi maze batanga igisubizo ntahishuye ukuri.
Gutabara kwanjye ku gihe byagaruriye roho y’ubuforomo ku muntu wari uyikeneye cyane.
Mu bikari by'abanyambaraga, naravuze nti: 'Ese nkwereke umuryango uzamurera kandi ukamurera neza?'
arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
